amend_reason: Claude Design Review (deleg_abf7e423) BLOCKED: P1 AGENT_MODEL_MISSING_WRITER_REVIEWER_SEPARATION_CONSTRAINT + 15 P2 findings

p1_resolution.root_cause: JSON Schema V1.0 allowed same agent_id as both WRITER and REVIEWER. No cross-entry validation existed.
resolution: Added writer_reviewer_separation: boolean (default: true) to mission contract schema V1.1
Added coordinator_writer_isolation: boolean (default: true) for R2+ missions
Created MissionContractValidator with cross-entry semantic validation
Rule 2: Writer-Reviewer separation enforced when writer_reviewer_separation=true
Rule 3: Coordinator-Writer isolation enforced for R2+ when coordinator_writer_isolation=true
Rule 4: Dual-permission conflict resolution (agent-level > mission-level, deny-by-default)

state_machine: ASSIGNED→PLANNING condition clarified: plan is FORMED during PLANNING, FROZEN at exit
RUNNING→BLOCKED actor unified to 'Writer' in both transition matrix and permission matrix
BLOCKED state now allows recovery to ASSIGNED, PLANNING, or RUNNING (not just RUNNING)
CTO cancellation extended to WAITING_REVIEW and VERIFYING states (direct cancel, no detour)
Lifecycle FSM terminal enforcement: added guard preventing MissionStateMachine ROLLED_BACK from reversing terminal lifecycle states
contract: Dual-permission conflict resolution: agent-level permissions take precedence; deny-by-default
required_evidence.produced_by now has enum constraint: [WRITER, REVIEWER, COORDINATOR, APPROVER, SYSTEM]
agent_model: Coordinator+Writer co-location prohibited for R2+ missions (coordinator_writer_isolation)
APPROVER role clarified: distinct from CTO; CTO always required for NSEC Article 37
recovery: Added lease expiration scenario: lease TTL < heartbeat interval detection
Added storage/disk-full failure: EvidenceStore write failure → degrade → retry
Added concurrent transition conflict: first-writer-wins with conflict detection
integration: Phase 1 target files clarified: NEW files in src/nexara_prime/ are IMPLEMENTATION, not modification of existing Runtime

changed_files.change: NEW: 5 validation rules with test fixtures
